scope: 93 Simplified Chinese resources for storage, player trade, personal stores, NPC shops and the main HUD
status: Source review completed; adopted terminology and English-behavior adaptations recorded. Resource XML and formatting placeholders validated.

feature_reviews.notes: Official documentation supplies the storage, expanded-storage and currency terminology. Titles, controls, password prompts and error messages follow the current English text and calling behavior. Current four-digit password behavior is preserved.

Official documentation supplies trade and currency terminology. Request, item-change, inventory-full and cancellation messages are translated from the current English meaning and preserve the current client behavior.

Official documentation supplies the store and currency terminology. W Coin labels remain product names. Price dialogs, confirmations, restrictions and status messages follow the current English text and behavior.

The merchant title, purchase confirmation, real-time tax label and reinforced-item restriction are translated from the current English meaning and calling behavior. Numeric and percent placeholders are unchanged.

Official interface and helper documentation supplies the HUD control terminology. Life, mana, AG, SD, experience, duration and cancellation strings follow the current English values and retain every formatting placeholder.
